name: edunest-saas
description: Run backend + Next.js website + React panel together

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix website install && npm --prefix panel install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,website,panel -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:website" "npm run dev:panel"
scripts.start: npm run seed && npm run dev
